name: Baloot
summary: Saudi four-player partnership trick-taking game derived from Belote with Hokum trumps or Sun no-trumps bidding.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships opposite. 32-card deck (7-A). Deal 5 cards each anticlockwise (3+2), expose next card. Bidding: first round each player in turn may Pass, bid Hokum (trumps = exposed suit, bidder takes exposed card) or Sun (no trumps). Sun overcalls Hokum; earlier Sun overcalls later Sun. If first three Pass, dealer or left may bid Ashkal (Sun but partner takes exposed card as declarer). If all Pass, second round: may bid Hokum in other suit (bidder names trump after taking card) or Sun. If still all Pass, hand void. Completing deal: declarer gets 2 more cards, others 3, for 8 each. Declarers must take >81 card points in Hokum (130 total inc last trick bonus) or >65 in Sun (130). Before play opponents may Double locked/open in Hokum; Triple, Quadruple, Gahwa can escalate. Sun Double only allowed when one team >100 and other <100. Play: right of dealer leads. Must follow suit in Sun. In Hokum must follow and must overtrump if able; if void may trump. Locked: cannot lead trump unless only trumps. Score card points plus projects (sequences and four-of-a-kind). First to 152 game points wins.
